File surface, read at objectui `main` `42bd926`:
- a new shell-level "this page holds unsaved edits" seam in `packages/app-shell/src` (a provider or registry plus a confirm helper), on the package entry if `apps/console` must reach it;
- the shell's button-driven departures:
  - `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx` (`:1146` docs, `:1224` profile, `:1250` and `:1260` organizations, plus `:1134`–`:1139`, `:1284`, `:1330` and `:390` of the same shape);
  - `packages/app-shell/src/layout/WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx` (`handleSwitch` `:81`–`:89`, which asks before `switchOrganization`; `:135`; `:144`);
  - `packages/app-shell/src/layout/SidebarItemMenu.tsx` (`:365`);
- the page guards that register with the seam: `apps/console/src/pages/settings/useUnsavedLeaveGuard.ts`, and `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`'s anchor guard (`:2148`–`:2190`) only if registering it is a small move;
- tests beside them;
- one changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`, `patch`).

Not the router (no `useBlocker` migration, no data router) and not browser Back/Forward. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this surface reads no path-derived mandate). Local, not cloud: nothing on it is build-heavy (no `packages/spec`), and cloud stays reserved for L/XL.
Clause-②: yes
Responsibility: the risk is produced by objectui's own shell, whose menu entries navigate from buttons that no page guard sees, and whose organization switch reloads the console after `set-active` with no prompt; the platform path that covers it: none (the edit is silently lost, and the organization has already switched); who reaches it: every user with unsaved edits on a guarded page who uses the header, avatar, workspace or sidebar menus.
Thread-read: none
The card had no comment at this claim. This seat filed it from a read-only census.
Serial constraints cleared: no open objectui PR and no in-flight claim touches `layout/AppHeader.tsx`, `layout/WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx`, `layout/SidebarItemMenu.tsx`, `useUnsavedLeaveGuard.ts`, `ResourceEditPage.tsx` or `app-shell/src/index.ts`. objectui#13225 and objectui#13229 (this seat) hold disjoint files.

Why `Clause-②: yes`: the seam must be reachable from `apps/console`, which likely means a new export on `@object-ui/app-shell`'s entry (a widening). 「拿不准 ⇒ 按 `yes`」. The dev reports which it was.
